Name: Horsemanship
Author: magimatica
Description:
Adds a more saddle-like saddle and a bridle, improves the farmer's seat, invents the stirrup, uses my own modified gallop animation, and includes a mule version!

To make the most of your horse experience, also check out [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7911]Horse Overhaul[/url]!

[b]Update 5/17/24:[/b] Elle's New Horses Compatibility!
If you would like to use my tack with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3169]Elle's New Horses[/url], please pick "Horse Type: None" and "Tack Type: Elles Style Tack" in the mod config.
[b]Update 5/7/24[/b]: 1.6 Compatibility!
Updated with the new adorable carrot-eating animations! Please let me know if you spot anything weird, this is not really thoroughly tested at time of upload.
[b]Update 8/4/18[/b]: CP Compatibility!
The main file for this mod is now a CP content pack. This version allows you to choose your horse and tack in the config file. It includes content for the vanilla-style horse with updated animations, and my mule. If you know what you're doing, you can take any (untacked) horse reskin you like and apply my tack to it! Also changes the icon in the menu to match your horse.
[b]Update 7/21/19[/b]: Now replaces only the relevant parts of the farmer base, so it is compatible with mods that change other parts of the farmer base, i.e. mods that affect the running animation. + small tweaks!
[b]Update 2/6/21[/b]: Now compatible with 1.5's baldness & pants :) Only mods the default pants.
